name: dk_sat_q1
cmd:
O=$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/out/dk_sat_q1; mkdir -p $O
python3 decor_build.py -- --theme satellite --out $O --tex 512 --ao 4 --only Dish_A,Dish_B,Mast,Solar,Drums,JBox,Fence,Scrub_A,Scrub_B,Saguaro,Barrel,Rock_A,Rock_B,Telescope,Control,Radar,FuelTank,Truck,BigDish,Array --shots $O/shots --each > $O/build.log 2>&1 || (tail -40 $O/build.log; exit 1)
rm -f $O/kit_hi.blend; ls -la $O $O/shots
